name: Somchai Wisutrattanakul
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for tinkering with engines as a young boy in Bangkok. He honed his skills at a local garage before securing a scholarship to study mechanical engineering abroad. His career took off after graduation when he landed a junior role with a Formula 3 team in Europe. There, he quickly gained experience in data analysis, car setup, and race strategy. 

Somchai is known for his meticulous approach to engineering, combining a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics with an ability to translate complex data into actionable changes. He emphasizes clear communication with drivers and mechanics, believing that a collaborative team is essential for success. Somchai's commitment to perfection, combined with his holistic view of race strategy, makes him a valuable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with slight recession at the temples
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a wiry build, often seen sporting a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Insists on having a cup of strong Thai iced tea before every race.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically on his clipboard when deep in thought.
